blocks.text: 30 sites, yards and cross-docks. Every trailer in or out gets inspected: seals, doors, tires, load, damage.
Inspectors work offline in the yards, signal is bad. Past the third row of trailers, no bars.
Today it's paper and photos on phones, typed up later. Or the tablet form fails to send and nobody goes back to resend.
Auditors need signed reports within 24 hours. Customer requirement on a lot of their contracts.
Signed = inspector signs, with the time. Auditors want a PDF, no logins.
